pillAnimationCorrection.cause: Compositor layer geometry animation and stale-buffer scaling during native bounds changes
pillAnimationCorrection.implementation: Stable screen-sized native canvas; child-only QML morph; scoped no_anim rule reapplied after compositor reload

pillAnimationCorrection.measurementConclusion: Inconclusive for a causal current performance gain or CPU regression. Final trials wait 20 seconds for compositor startup; baseline and corrected canvas both exhibit high CPU. The broader historical bounded-window gains do not describe current code.
